Coram : ADARSH KUMAR GOEL*, R.F. NARIMAN
Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 – s.11 – Res judicata – General rule and its exceptions – Erroneous decision given on a statutory prohibition in former suit – Statutory prohibition not given effect to – Plea of res judicata in subsequent suit – Held: An the same parties in a subsequent suit or proceeding is not res judicata if, by an erroneous decision given on a statutory prohibition in the former suit or proceeding, the statutory prohibition is not given effect to – On facts, respondent in order to repay dues of the bank, signed
Decision Date : 20-04-2018 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 4233/2018 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
